firstPlayerRule: Choose the first player at random, or give the first turn to whoever owns the most cats.
clarifications: Other players follow clockwise. The first player is player 1 in the scenario setup, with subsequent player numbers assigned to their left.

sources.title: Ankh: Gods of Egypt — CMON English rulebook

internalEvidence: Rendered page 13 of the final CMON-hosted English rulebook. Setup step 4 offers either random selection or the player who owns the most cats; clockwise seating order follows. Step 9 maps the first player to scenario player 1. Source SHA-256: ccfaa04d644e1bccf88439f9285fded0ffb9badd4700854ead2fefd69b8bac6c. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the rendered publisher setup page.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not specify a tie-break if multiple players own the same greatest number of cats.
